title: Design Token Spec
description: Validates a design token proposal document. Governs primitive, semantic, and component tokens with tier-specific requirements, theming coverage, and contrast enforcement.

name.description: Hyphenated token name, unique within the tier and the system.

tier.description: Which token tier this proposal belongs to. Tier determines change governance and which files are affected.

version.description: Semantic version of this token spec.

governanceTrack.description: Fast track for patches and docs-only changes; standard for all new tokens, semantic changes, and component API changes.

supersedes.description: Name of the token this one replaces, or null if this is a new addition.

rationale.description: One-paragraph justification: what surface or component needs this value, and why the existing token set cannot serve it.

proposedValue.description: The token value(s). For primitives: raw value. For semantic: resolves-to primitive name plus optional transform. For component: the semantic token overridden and the override value.

consumptionSurfaces.description: At least two surfaces or components where this token will be used. A token with one consumption surface should be a component-level override instead.

themeImplications.description: Values across all supported themes. A token with missing theme values will produce invisible or low-contrast UI in that theme.

light.description: Value or resolution in the light theme. Use null if the token does not apply in this theme.

dark.description: Value or resolution in the dark theme. Use null if the token does not apply in this theme.

highContrast.description: Value or resolution in the high-contrast theme. Use null if the token does not apply in this theme.

contrastCheck.description: Required for semantic foreground tokens. Declares the foreground/background pair and the expected WCAG ratio.

expectedRatio.description: Expected contrast ratio as a decimal or ratio string.

migrationPath.description: If supersedes is set, a mapping of old token names to new ones. If this is an additive token with no replacement, write the string 'No migration needed.'

openQuestions.description: Open items that must be resolved before approval.

allOf.description: Semantic foreground tokens must include a contrast check.
Standard track tokens require at least two consumption surfaces.
Superseding tokens must have a migration path that is not 'No migration needed.'
